lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Heya, friend!

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Hope I didn't keep you waiting too long.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: But, the wait is finally over!

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: I've got a big ol' hefty boy just waiting for us to check out.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: It's gonna be like nothing you've ever seen before!
Won't it be dangerous?
Looking forward to it!

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Sorry, but it's going to be hard guaranteeing your complete safety this time, though.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: All right? Hahaha!

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: But you have to keep in mind

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: that this is far more dangerous than our previous excursion.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: These guys are wild beasts in every sense of the world.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: They can be extremely unpredictable.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: But I have a list of precautions

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: I'll be going over with you before we come face-to-face with them.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: So long as you follow those precautions,

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: nothing bad will happen to you.
What do you mean by precautions?

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: For example...

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: You must never EVER

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: show signs of weaknesses, like limping or a weakened energy core,

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: in front of a Master-class Rapture.
Why is that?
Could it be that...

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: That's right! Hahaha!

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Just like how the wildlife of yesteryear had a food chain,

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: these fellas do as well.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: It's sad to see how injured and weak animals

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: are inevitably being targeted by predators in any ecosystem.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: I'll go over the details with you in person.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: We can meet at the rendezvous point.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Oh, and your Nikke friends...
I'll make sure they keep their distance.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Perfect!
